# Terms outside Latin-1

Every term here is marked at one level, so each has one entry line of its
own in the printed index and no parent line above it. The YAML above is the
recipe README's `### Terms outside Latin-1` section documents: the engine
and a main font that covers the scripts marked below. The font is named by
file, which is what makes the render load the TeX Live package rather than
whatever the operating system carries under the family name `STIX Two Text`.

- [θεωρία]{.index} — Greek, with a precomposed accented vowel.
- [ψυχή]{.index sort="psyche"} — Greek again, carrying a sort key so it files under the Latin spelling.
- [Москва]{.index} — Cyrillic.
- [źródło]{.index} — Polish, three Latin letters beyond Latin-1.
- [Việt]{.index} — Vietnamese, a vowel carrying two marks.
- [café]{.index} — written as `e` plus a combining acute rather than the precomposed letter.
- [Nux̌alk]{.index} — `x` plus a combining caron, a sequence with no precomposed form at all.
- [Ascii]{.index} — plain ASCII: the control renders below prove their index printed at all by finding this one.
